message.content: I'm ending my turn without making any changes. I'm on Park Place, which p1 owns, but it's mortgaged so no rent is due. The bank has no houses left, so I can't build. Getting Park Place to complete the dark blues wouldn't help right now for the same reason. Unmortgaging the Pennsylvania Railroad would cost $110 for only $25 rent, so I'm keeping my $395 as a cushion against p1's oranges and magentas, where rent runs to about $750.

Given p1's strong oranges and magentas, there's not much pressure I can apply. Unmortgaging the Pennsylvania Railroad for $110 to get $25 rent isn't worthwhile, so I'll just hold my cash and end the turn.
